Singer Chinmayi Sripaada, Sunitha Upadrashta clash over feminism and online comments

Singer Chinmayi Sripaada has criticized fellow singer Sunitha Upadrashta for her remarks on feminism. Sripaada also called for action against a man who made an "my acid, my choice" comment. Upadrashta responded to Sripaada's criticism, stating she was "not okay with it" after being called out for her statement, which was interpreted as "his eyes, his wish."
